1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2916|427db4a9.name: Historian Karnik
2916|427db4a9.text: Welcome to the Explorer's League.  If you need information, and it is in book form, then I might be able to help you out.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

5172|86b6c1ef.name: Briarthorn
5172|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5172|8fca8484.name: Briarthorn
5172|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5502|fb513610.name: Shylamiir
5502|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

279-progress.name: Karl Boran
279-progress.text: Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those Murlocs.
279-progress.title: Claws from the Deep

289-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-progress.text: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good madam, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
289-progress.title: The Cursed Crew

292-progress.name: Glorin Steelbrow
292-progress.text: That drunk Fitzsimmons sent you to me? Well, you can tell him I don't have any extra ale. He's going to have to panhandle someone else!
292-progress.title: The Eye of Paleth

296-progress.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-progress.text: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
296-progress.title: Ormer's Revenge

299-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-progress.text: Have you uncovered the four fragments yet, $N?  Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru...
299-progress.title: Uncovering the Past

471-progress.name: James Halloran
471-progress.text:
My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

Ah, $N, how goes it?  Do you have my skins?
471-progress.title: Apprentice's Duties

92456-accept.name: Shylamiir
92456-accept.text:
If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456-accept.title: A Green Sample

98071-progress.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-progress.text: Lookin' ta try a new ale?
98071-progress.title: Brewer's Trade

98189-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98189-progress.text: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189-progress.title: Return the Statuette

98310-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
98310-complete.text:
By Magni's beard, they're beautiful! Wait a second, do you see that?! Hold the hearts closer to the Goaz Stone for a moment...

<New text reveals itself on the stone in a faint shimmering light.>

Hmm, it's hard to make out. "Curse of Flesh... they will fail." What's that supposed to mean?!

We've got to get this somewhere safe so we can study it further!
98310-complete.title: Gleaning Our Future

98310-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
98310-progress.text: Be careful out there. I suspect these constructs will be tougher than the warder was.
98310-progress.title: Gleaning Our Future

98313-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
98313-accept.text:
Whatever this is all about, $N, it's epic stuff alright.

I'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.

It'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
98313-accept.title: For Further Study

98313-complete.name: Historian Karnik
98313-complete.text:
Well I'll be...

This is a lot to go through! Very exciting, though. VERY exciting!

It'll take me some time to even put a plan together on this one. Come back another time and I can give you the latest. For now, please accept the thanks of the Explorers' League.
98313-complete.title: For Further Study

98313-progress.name: Historian Karnik
98313-progress.text: Apologies, I'm terribly, terribly busy. Did you need something?
98313-progress.title: For Further Study
